purpose: the null an activity-conditioned generator must beat, AND a measurement of whether the oracle's activity signal is k-mer-expressible at all

checked: positional refuses a non-dividing bin count
precondition.why: values are hand-derived from the definitions, so this is a CORRECTNESS check and not a record of current output. It RAISES rather than returning a verdict, because a floor that never computes is not a failing floor -- it is no floor.
precondition.limit: it pins the FEATURE pipeline, not the fitted ridge: a changed linear-algebra backend that still builds identical features would pass this and must be caught by the end-to-end value pin in the test suite.

leak.note: the previous key was named folds_untouched, which was FALSE -- the real_ceiling arm reads these folds (scored, never fitted). Renamed rather than silently kept.

ceiling_diagnostics.why: the ceiling is the DENOMINATOR of stratified_frac_of_ceiling, so its own sampling noise propagates into every fraction quoted against it. Reported as a measured spread because the bar refuses frozen numeric tolerances.
ceiling_diagnostics.superseded_estimator_note: a first-n subsample of an activity-SORTED stratum was used before 2026-11-22; it understated this quantity (K562 by 0.1095 = -4.14 sd, HepG2 by 0.0300 = -2.74 sd) by truncating each stratum's top edge

ceiling_relative.ceiling_estimator: all held-out records per stratum -- the lowest-variance estimate. Per-cell matched-n draws and their spread are in cells.*.ceiling_diagnostics.
ceiling_relative.frac_sd_note: first-order propagation of the DENOMINATOR's spread only. The null arm's own seed spread is NOT included, so this is a floor on each fraction's uncertainty and not its total.

verdict_detail: The stratified 4-mer null captures K562 42.2%, HepG2 51.3% of the achievable monotonicity (ceiling K562 0.4912, HepG2 0.4537 from real sequence stratified by its own measured activity), while an UNCONDITIONED chain captures K562 5.0%, HepG2 8.0% -- so the signal is genuinely coming from the conditioning and not from the generation process. A real bar with real room left. A generator must be quoted against BOTH the null and the ceiling; beating the null while far below the ceiling is a partial result.
